There are 5 time periods in each day.\nBut only 3 are working periods:\n• Morning\n• Afternoon\n• Dusk=每一天有5个时段。\n但只有3个是劳作时段:\n・ 上午\n・ 下午\n・ 黄昏
About Time=关于时间
All interactions marked with the  symbol will skip 1 time period.=所有标有  符号的互动都会跳过1个时段。
All goals marked with the  icon will skip one time period.=所有标有  符号的目标都会跳过1个时段。
You will lose 1  for each time period that passes by.=每过一个时段、你就会消耗1个  。
You will lose 1 x  for each time period that passes by.\nThat's 6 x  a day!=每过一个时段、你就会消耗1个 。\n一天就要消耗6个 !
Managing Stamina=体力管理
All Story Events are marked with the  symbol.\nSome, marked by the  symbol, will skip 1 time period.=所有剧情事件都标有  符号。\n其中一些标有  符号的会跳过1个时段。
Story Events=剧情事件
All Love Events are marked with the  symbol.\nEach Love Event will skip 1 time period.=所有恋爱事件都标有  符号。\n每个恋爱事件都会跳过1个时段。
All Romantic Dates are marked with the  icon.\nEach date will skip one time period!=所有约会都标有  符号。\n每次约会都会跳过1个时段!
Love Events=恋爱事件
You'll get a Love Heart  by choosing the right answer.\nCheck your progress in the Relationships menu!=选对答案就能获得一颗爱心  。\n可在人际关系菜单中查看你的进度!
You'll get a Love Heart  after every successful date.\nCheck your progress in the Relationships Menu!=每次约会成功后都能获得一颗爱心  。\n可在人际关系菜单中查看你的进度!
All Tasks are marked with the  symbol.\nEach Task will skip 1 time period.=所有任务都标有  符号。\n每个任务都会跳过1个时段。
All available Tasks are marked with the  icon.\nEach task you do will skip one time period!=所有任务都标有  符号。\n每个任务都会跳过1个时段!
Tasks=任务
You'll get a different reward  depending on your performance.\nUse your  wisely at the various shops !=根据你的表现、你会获得不同的奖励  。\n善用你的  、多去各处商店  逛逛吧!
Press [C] to turn on your lantern!=按[C]键点亮你的提灯!
Preserve your matches!=省着点用你的火柴!
You can use Matches  for your lantern and objects marked with the  symbol.\nThey're finite, so use them wisely!=你可以用火柴  点亮提灯、或用于标有  符号的物件。\n它们数量有限、要省着用!
Suspicion=嫌疑
Avoid Suspicion!=避免引起嫌疑!
Every time you act suspiciously, your Suspicion  will increase.\nYou'd best mind what you say!=每次你举止可疑、你的嫌疑  就会增加。\n说话前最好想清楚!
Muffy's spying on you!=穆菲正在监视你!
Successfully bribe Muffy with a Food Item .\nIf not, your Suspicion  will increase.=用食物道具  成功贿赂穆菲。\n否则、你的嫌疑  会增加。
Look out for Rozenmarine!=留意萝森玛琳的动向!
Rozenmarine will wander about town when you don't take her along for a Task [broom].=如果你做任务[broom]时没有带上萝森玛琳、她就会在镇上到处乱逛。
If you don't find her and fix her blunders, your Suspicion [hat] will increase.=如果你没找到她并处理好她闯的祸、你的嫌疑[hat]就会增加。
